https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761991860

help.title: Help
help.stopMethodBody: You can choose from 6 alarm stop methods in Settings: photo scan, shake, tap, rapid tap, math, and typing. When an alarm fires, complete the selected mission to stop it.
help.routineBody: A routine is a sequence of steps. Scheduled routines start automatically at the set time, while manual routines start when you tap them. Each routine can have up to 3 steps.
help.alarmRoutineBody: When creating an alarm, add up to 3 steps to make it an alarm routine. When the alarm fires, the first step begins. Completing each step advances to the next, and the routine ends when all steps are done.
help.dialBody: Before starting the timer, rotate the dial with your finger to set the time. While paused, you can increase or decrease the time the same way, and tapping resume restarts with the new time.
help.stopButtonBody: To stop a running timer or routine, press and hold the center play/pause button. A gauge fills around the button and it stops after about 1 second. A short tap pauses or resumes.
help.tabSwipeBody: You can switch between the bottom tabs (Timer, Routine, Alarm, Calendar, Settings) by swiping left or right. Swiping on a list card triggers delete first, so swipe on empty areas or the edges to change tabs.
help.bugBody: If you find a bug, tap the email icon at the top right of the home screen to open the bug report screen. Write the scenario (what was happening) and the description (what went wrong), then tap send. The mail app opens automatically with device info attached.
